direct_field_trial.interpretation_limit: Retain all samples. Direct-field loses separated wide64 replacement and wide churn despite a wide4096 replacement gain; no library or layout selection follows. The current source is the restored running-index control.

pre_registered_criterion.text:
Direct-field replacement discriminator, recorded before applying candidate:
Keep the current running-index library as the control. The source candidate matches the borrowed bucket and swaps its saved key/value fields with offered locals, returning the complete old pair; insertion and migration retain the shared exchange helper. Preserve hash/equality order and arguments, full refusal, tombstone search and all ownership outcomes. No layout or API change.
First compile the unchanged mutation witness and inspect the reached wide replacement path. Require removal of the retained exchange call and its avoidable staging without extra hot calls or spills; unchanged or worse generated work rejects this hypothesis without a timing claim. The owned-parameter entry snapshot may remain.
If code generation supports the hypothesis, compare the frozen running-index control and candidate with the same driver, Rust/C++ objects, runtime, seeds, half-load capacities, full-payload construction/observation, same-owner warmup and 1,048,576 logical operations. Two reversed-order cohorts, retain every sample. Apply the existing full-range/stability criterion; a replacement gain with no separated regression supports retention. Independently verify all images and allocation ledgers before timing. Do not infer migration cost or a new layout choice from replacement.
The prior rejected exchange duplication was inside migration and did not establish independent benefit; this experiment leaves migration unchanged and tests the replacement path directly.
